topic: What if you got a five-star wanted level in real life?

script.text: You cross the road while the little man is still red. Ding. A gold star lights up above your head. Ten seconds later, a police bike turns the corner.
So you run. Two stars. Sirens, from three directions at once.
You hide behind the skate park. Three stars. A helicopter rises over the rooftops, and its searchlight finds you straight away.
Four stars. Roadblocks on every bridge out of town. Your face on every screen in the mall.
A man in the food court looks up from his phone, at the screen, then at you. Then back at the screen. Then he slowly puts his burger down.
And then the fifth star lights up. Every police officer in the city now has one job today. You. All because you crossed on red.
What if you got a five-star wanted level in real life?
